name: MCP: error spans
select: Timestamp, SpanName, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool, SpanAttributes['status_category'] AS status, ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, TraceId

name: MCP: tool calls over 2 seconds
select: Timestamp, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool, round(Duration / 1e6) AS ms, SpanAttributes['status_category'] AS status, ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, TraceId

name: MCP: logs with a trace
select: Timestamp, TraceId, SeverityText, Body, ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment

name: MCP: auth failures
select: Timestamp, SpanAttributes['status_category'] AS status, SpanAttributes['mcp.persona'] AS persona, SpanAttributes['mcp.transport'] AS transport, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool, ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment

name: MCP: configuration warnings
select: Timestamp, LogAttributes['code'] AS code, Body, ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment

name: MCP: API gateway upstream 5xx
select: Timestamp, SpanAttributes['mcp.connection'] AS connection, SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] AS status, SpanName, ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, TraceId
